description: Ministry of Natural Resources road segments is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Information about roads under Ministry of Natural Resources (MNR) jurisdiction may fall within the responsibility of several different ministry branches and including: Forests Division Parks, Lands & Waters Branch Resource access roads The dataset also contains roads not under the jurisdiction of the MNR like municipal roads and provincial highways. Coverage: Government of Ontario. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Ontario | Gouvernement de l'Ontario. Its tags are Economy and Business, Environment and Natural Resources, Infrastructure and Transportation, Driving and roads, Government information. It offers 6 resource(s) in ESRI REST, HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence – Ontario. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
